name: HookForms Self-Hosted Webhook Inbox
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form submission and webhook inbox software; no provider-imposed subscription or submission quota. Default 100 requests per 60 seconds per IP, 2 MB request body, and 10 emails per 10 minutes per inbox.
watch_out: Requires own Docker hosting, PostgreSQL, Redis, DNS and configured notification channels; external email/SMS providers may charge. Default event retention is 30 days. Rate limits apply; project is relatively new.
